scenes.text: The highest common factor is the largest number that divides both numbers. Factor trees and prime factors help.
Find HCF(12, 40). The answer is 4. Highest common factor equals 4.
Two groups in the class garden hold 20 and 6 items. What is the greatest size of identical packets that divides both totals? Pause the video and think.
